# huggingface_repository (Resource)

Manage a model repository's identity and visibility. Files and artifact commits are never managed. Retain is the default destroy policy; replacement leaves retained repositories intact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "huggingface_repository" "example" {
  namespace       = "your-hf-namespace"
  name            = "example-model"
  private         = true
  deletion_policy = "retain"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Repository name. Changes require replacement.
- `namespace` (String) Owning Hugging Face user or organization.

### Optional

- `deletion_policy` (String) Local destroy policy: retain (default) or delete. Imports default to retain.
- `private` (Boolean) Private visibility, default true. Updated in place.
- `repo_type` (String) Repository type; v1 supports model only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import identity model/namespace/name.
- `repo_id` (String) Repository identity namespace/name.
- `url` (String) Repository URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import is read-only and defaults to retain on destroy.
tofu import huggingface_repository.example model/your-hf-namespace/example-model
```
